title: State Interface Standards for Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44)
content:
These standards govern how a Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44) certificate reaches the state and how the state answers. They are the same for all six certificates (SR-22 Owner, Operator and Owner-Operator; FR-44 Owner, Operator and Owner-Operator).

| Standard | Value |
|---|---|
| Transmission of a requested certificate | within 1 business day after the filing request |
| Business-day calendar | Monday to Friday, excluding New Year's Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving and Christmas |
| How certificates and SR-26 notices reach the state | electronic state interface |
| State acknowledgment (acceptance or rejection) of a transmission | within 3 business days |
| Window for transmitting a corrected filing after a state rejection | 10 calendar days; otherwise the request is withdrawn |
| Rejection reasons cured by correcting the filer data and retransmitting | license number mismatch; name mismatch; date of birth mismatch |
| Cure of a policy-limits-insufficient rejection | the backing term is moved to the minimum backing package, then the certificate is retransmitted |
| Rejection reasons that end the request (it is withdrawn) | no requirement on record |
| Filer data that must match the state driver record exactly | the filed driver's name, license number and date of birth |
| Effective date certified on the filing | the later of the backing term's effective date and the request date |

### Worked readings (hypothetical dates)

- **Business days.** A filing requested on a Friday is transmitted by the next business day, the Monday. If that Monday is Memorial Day, the next business day is the Tuesday.
- **Acknowledgment.** A transmission made on a Tuesday in a week with no listed holiday is acknowledged by the state within 3 business days, that is, by the Friday.
- **Effective date, request later.** A backing term effective on the 3rd of a month with a filing requested on the 9th certifies from the 9th.
- **Effective date, term later.** A term bound to take effect on the 20th with a filing requested on the 14th certifies from the 20th.

### Rejection reasons at a glance

- **Cured by correcting filer data:** license number mismatch, name mismatch, date of birth mismatch.
- **Cured only by moving the backing term to the minimum backing package:** policy limits insufficient.
- **Ends the request:** no requirement on record.
